developer_request: AutoAgent crashes on WSL2 while starting the browser environment with OSError: handle is closed. Fix it.
known_facts: The report includes a concrete platform, command, traceback, and old source line references.
The issue was opened in 2025 and remained open in 2026, so the reported baseline may differ materially from current head.
Discussion suggests a multiprocessing start-method hypothesis, but comments are not verified root cause.
A workaround based on recloning or deleting the repository would not explain or fix the defect.
expected_first_moves: compare the reported version/source path with the current implementation before editing
check whether the reported failing code path and forced multiprocessing behavior still exist
reproduce on the closest practical platform or build a focused compatibility test when exact WSL2 reproduction is unavailable
treat issue comments as hypotheses to test rather than accepted fixes
must_preserve: the reported environment and traceback as historical evidence
platform-specific behavior that may differ between Linux, WSL2, macOS, and Windows
must_not: assume an old traceback describes current head without checking
apply a comment-suggested code change without testing its causal relationship
delete or reclone the repository as a substitute for root-cause analysis
declare fixed solely because current code looks different
lessons: Bug intake needs a baseline-freshness check before reproduction and root-cause work.
Historical issue evidence must be preserved but cannot silently become current fact.
When exact environment reproduction is unavailable, the route should seek the strongest bounded compatibility evidence rather than guess.
